en: Vintage monochrome illustrated postcard showing a hilly landscape with a town in a valley and a prominent hilltop castle or fortress. In the foreground are figures on horseback and people walking near trees and rocks. The town has a church with a tall tower and clustered houses. Decorative German text panels frame the image, and stylized script in a cartouche identifies the scene as Badenweiler under the rule of Margrave Georg Friedrich (1595–1638), with additional German captions along the sides and bottom.
